title: InsightPilot AI — What-If Simulation Contract
description: Defines input parameters, deterministic projection outputs, and assumption structures for the what-if simulation engine.

simulation_id.description: Unique identifier for the simulation execution run

simulation_name.description: Descriptive title of the simulated scenario
simulation_name.example: Atlanta DC Inventory Restoration & Volume Rebate Impact

input_variable.description: Controllable operational or commercial parameter being adjusted

target_facility_or_scope.description: Geographic or operational boundary of the simulation

baseline_value.description: Current observed baseline state before intervention

scenario_value.description: Target slider value selected by the user

projected_metric.description: Primary output KPI receiving projected recovery

projected_value.description: Estimated new KPI value under simulated conditions

recovery_timeframe_days.description: Estimated elapsed days required to realize projected impact

assumptions.description: Explicit mathematical and operational assumptions governing the deterministic model
example: Inter-DC stock transfer of 18,500 units from Charlotte completes within 72 hours
Unmet customer order demand remains recapturable with zero permanent brand substitution
Tier-1 distributor re-order elasticity is 0.85 relative to stock availability
Direct emergency freight cost modeled at $24,500
